text: Hello! Let's sign in for the first time, as Business Owner, on your mobile.

text: First, keep three things ready: your shop link, your Business ID, and your 7-digit PIN. FRUiTIFY gives you these when your shop is set up.

text: Tap Business Owner, Operations Head, Store Manager.

text: Type your Business ID. Your shop name appears. Tap Continue.

text: Type your 7-digit PIN and tap Sign In. If the PIN is wrong, type it again carefully.

text: Well done! Your Management Console is open.
